paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness tools for CAD drawing translation
# DeepSeek Harness CAD translation plugin

Translate the text inside DXF/DWG drawings from a DeepSeek Harness
session, then download the transl
ated drawing or the extracted text workbook.

The plugin is a thin consumer of the separately installed CAD Translation System
backend. Conversion

, text extraction, LLM translation and back-fill all stay in
the backend's own async task pipeline;

the plugin only uploads a drawing,
follows the task, and fetches the finished artifacts.
## What it adds
| Tool | Purpose |

| `cad_translate` | Upload a local `.dxf`/`.dwg`, choose the target language, get a task id. |
| `ca
d_translation_status` | Read one task's status/stage/progress, optionally its log tail; list recent

tasks when no id is given. |
| `cad_download_drawing` | Save the back-filled drawing (`translated_ca
d`) or the text workbook (`excel`) locally. |
## Requirements
| Item | Version / note |

| DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `0.2.1-rc.5` (the supported and tested version). |
| Node.js | Node 24
verified for Harness 0.2.1-rc.5. The standalone plugin tests also run on Node 22; Node 22.14 did not

start the Harness CLI. |
| CAD translation backend | The separately installed CAD Translation Syste
m FastAPI backend. |

Harness is in developer preview and can break compatibility between releases.
The package is restric

ted to the verified version. The `--network` test uses
the pinned rc.5 tools and does not verify a n

ewer Harness; upgrading requires
testing installation and a real session against the target version.
## Install
### 1. Start the backend

Install and start the CAD Translation System backend.
Configure a model provider for full translatio
n; the backend runs separately.

### 3. Install and load in Harness

The following commands are for macOS/Linux. Use Node 24, Harness 0.2.1-rc.5,
and pnpm on PATH. Run f
rom the repository root:

Open the address printed by Harness and start a session. The bundle registers
its tools once in the

Host registry: agent presets inherit them unless they
restrict or shadow those tools. Restart Harnes

s after installing or removing the
bundle. Users of the previous generated profile patch should stop

passing that
patch when upgrading to this version to avoid duplicate registration.
Windows installa
tion and DWG conversion have not yet been verified.
## Use
Start a session and ask in natural language:
> Translate `~/projects/plan.dxf` to Japanese, then save the result next to the original.

The model calls `cad_translate`, then polls `cad_translation_status`, then calls
`cad_download_drawi
ng`. You can also ask directly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Statuses reported: `queued`, `processing`, `done`, `partial`, `error`,
`cancelled`. A task is settle

d once it reaches `done`, `partial`, `error` or
`cancelled`; anything else is still running. `partia

l` means some text failed to
translate, and `failed_count` says how many.
## How paths resolve

* An absolute `file_path` is used as given.
* A relative `file_path` resolves against the Session wo

rking directory.
* Downloads go to `output_dir`, or to `CAD_TRANSLATION_OUTPUT_DIR` /
`backend.outpu

tDir` (default `.cad-translation`) under the Session working
directory.
* The backend checks the upl

oad extension (`.dxf`/`.dwg`), size
(`MAX_FILE_SIZE`, 100 MB by default) and task ids (8 hex charact
## Credentials

* `CAD_TRANSLATION_ADMIN_TOKEN` is the backend's `ADMIN_API_TOKEN`, not an LLM
key. LLM credentials

stay in `backend/.env` or the backend's runtime config
and never reach the plugin.
* The token trave

ls as the `X-Admin-Token` header. Exact token values in returned strings and error messages are
reda

cted; schema field names are unchanged, and transformed or partial values
echoed by a server cannot

be reliably recognized.
* With `ENABLE_ADMIN_GUARD=true` and no `ADMIN_API_TOKEN`, the backend rejec

ts
every protected route with `503`; the plugin reports that as an actionable
error instead of retry
keep private drawings out of committed directories.
## Limitations

* **The backend must run somewhere reachable.** Uploads go over plain HTTP; put
TLS in front of the

backend for anything other than a local or trusted
network.
* **DWG conversion depends on the backen

d host.** DWG input needs AutoCAD,
Gmei/浩辰, ODA File Converter, or the bundled LibreDWG on the backe

nd machine.
`converter_backend: "dxf_only"` skips conversion entirely and is what the
tests use.
* *

*Translation needs a configured provider.** Without an LLM provider the task
ends in `error`; `extra

ct_only: true` still produces the workbook.
* **Downloads do not overwrite existing files.** Choose
a different file name or output directory when the target exists. Backend URLs must point directly t

o the service: redirects are rejected.
* **Files are uploaded, not linked.** The plugin reads the fi

le from disk and
sends it to the backend, so very large drawings cost one upload per task.
* **No ca

ncel/delete tools.** The backend exposes stop/delete routes, but they
are not wrapped here; ask the

backend UI or API for those.
* **One task at a time per call.** `cad_translate` queues and returns
i

mmediately (`background=true`); there is no client-side waiting or progress
streaming, so the model

polls.
* **UI cards are generic.** The tools declare no `presentCall`/`presentResult`
projections, s

o the Web client renders the default card with the model-facing
text.
## Development and verification
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The smoke installs fixed Node, pnpm and Harness versions in a temporary directory,
then installs the

packed plugin and checks a real session with a local fake
model and backend. It requires network ac
cess, but no model API key.
